chose: Home serves WALK5's friction measures (C861) as raw per-affordance rows in the weekly engagement read it already keeps per week in report_week. Over the 28 owner days ending with the week: days opened per affordance; lefts per place, how many had a same-instant take of the same affordance, and the median time; Applying's debrief count and median. seen gains lastOpenedDay for silence (#3338). gray: Which module a row belongs to, and whether a quiet module is silent or not measured, is a fact only the registry holds. A copy on home, even under a contract, would be a second list that can drift from the build, and a drift there calls a live module a graveyard. That is the reading #3338 forbids. No check can settle which side should own that interpretation; it is a design call.
undo: Move the derivation to home behind a registry contract, and keep the raw rows as its input.
